nodes.body_text: byName = <T extends { name: string }>(list: T[], name: string) => { const n = norm(name); return list.find((x) => norm(x.name) === n); }

nodes.body_text: // Deriva as cartas de ação da ficha. Puro: sem React. import { ACTION_COST_LABEL, COMBAT_ACTIONS, abilityModifier, featureActionCost, getBackground, getClass, getRace, getSpell, spellActionCost, type ActionCost, type Spell, type Weapon, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { activeSpellcasting, derivedStats, getSheet, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import type { EntryRef } from '@/components/entries'; import { spellRollFor } from '@/components/spells/filters'; import { normalizeText } from '@/components/spells/spell-utils'; import { lookupItem, weaponProficient } from './equipment-logic'; /** Slot do turno gasto ao usar a carta. */ export const SECTIONS: { id: CardSection; title: string; color: string }[] = [ { id: 'acao', title: 'Ação', color: '#6366f1' }, { id: 'bonus', title: 'Ação bônus', color: '#f5c451' }, { id: 'reacao', title: 'Reação', color: '#38bdf8' }, { id: 'truque', title: 'Truques', color: '#8b5cf6' }, { id: 'outro', title: 'Conjuração longa', color: '#94a3b8' }, ]; /** Primeira frase do texto, limitada para caber na carta. */ /** Resumos em que a primeira frase não diz o que a característica faz. */ const SUMMARY_OVERRIDES: Record<string, string> = { 'Ação Ardilosa': 'Disparada, Desengajar ou Esconder como ação bônus.', }; /* ---------- Armas ---------- */ /* ---------- Magias ---------- */ const SAVE_ABBR: Record<string, string> = { forca: 'FOR', destreza: 'DES', constituicao: 'CON', inteligencia: 'INT', sabedoria: 'SAB', carisma: 'CAR', }; /** Dano do truque cresce nos níveis 5, 11 e 17 do personagem. */ /* ---------- Lista completa ---------- */ /** Condições que dão desvantagem em ataques (diferente de testes de habilidade). */ /** Menor círculo com espaço livre para conjurar a magia. Retorna null quando não há. */

nodes.name: asSlot
nodes.body_text: asSlot = (cost: ActionCost): TurnSlot | null => (cost === 'acao' || cost === 'bonus' || cost === 'reacao' ? cost : null)

nodes.body_text: turnSlot = (card: ActionCard) => asSlot(card.cost)

nodes.body_text: sectionOf = (cost: ActionCost): CardSection => asSlot(cost) ?? 'outro'

nodes.name: firstSentence
nodes.body_text: function firstSentence(text: string, max = 120): string { const line = text.split('\n')[0]!.trim(); const end = line.search(/[.!?](\s|$)/); const s = end > 0 ? line.slice(0, end + 1) : line; return s.length > max ? `${s.slice(0, max - 1).trimEnd()}…` : s; }

nodes.signature: function weaponCard(c: Character, sheet: SheetData, w: Weapon, attackBonus: number, key: string): ActionCard
nodes.body_text: function weaponCard(c: Character, sheet: SheetData, w: Weapon, attackBonus: number, key: string): ActionCard { const d = derivedStats(c); const str = abilityModifier(c.strength); const dex = abilityModifier(c.dexterity); const finesse = w.properties.some((p) => normalizeText(p).startsWith('acuidade')); const ranged = w.kind === 'À distância'; const mod = ranged ? dex : finesse ? Math.max(str, dex) : str; const prof = weaponProficient(getClass(sheet.classId), w); const bonus = mod + (prof ? d.pb : 0) + attackBonus; const dice = w.damage.match(/^\d+d\d+/)?.[0]; const damage: DamageRoll[] = []; if (dice) damage.push({ label: 'Dano', expr: `${dice}${fmtMod(mod)}` }); const sneak = sheet.classId === 'ladino' && (finesse || ranged) ? `${Math.ceil(c.level / 2)}d6` : null; if (sneak) damage.push({ label: 'Furtivo', expr: sneak }); return { key, section: 'acao', name: w.name, cost: 'acao', costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL.acao, source: `Arma ${w.kind === 'À distância' ? 'à distância' : 'corpo a corpo'}`, summary: w.properties.join(' · ') || 'Sem propriedades especiais.', stats: [ `Ataque ${bonus >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${bonus}${prof ? '' : ' (sem proficiência)'}`, dice ? `${dice}${fmtMod(mod)} ${w.damage.slice(dice.length).trim()}` : w.damage, ...(sneak ? [`Ataque Furtivo +${sneak}`] : []), ], entry: { kind: 'weapon', name: w.name }, attack: { label: `Ataque com ${w.name}`, bonus }, damage, }; }

nodes.name: cantripTier
nodes.body_text: cantripTier = (level: number) => (level >= 17 ? 4 : level >= 11 ? 3 : level >= 5 ? 2 : 1)

nodes.name: spellDamage
nodes.signature: function spellDamage(s: Spell, level: number): DamageRoll | null
nodes.body_text: function spellDamage(s: Spell, level: number): DamageRoll | null { const r = spellRollFor(s, s.level); if (!r) return null; const label = r.kind === 'cura' ? 'Cura' : 'Dano'; if (s.level > 0) return { label, expr: r.expr }; const m = r.expr.match(/^(\d+)(d.+)$/); return { label, expr: m ? `${Number(m[1]) * cantripTier(level)}${m[2]}` : r.expr }; }

nodes.name: spellCard
nodes.signature: function spellCard(c: Character, s: Spell): ActionCard
nodes.body_text: function spellCard(c: Character, s: Spell): ActionCard { const spell = derivedStats(c).spell; const cost = spellActionCost(s); const text = normalizeText(s.description); const hasAttack = /jogada de ataque|ataque (magico|com magia)/.test(text); const save = text.match(/(?:teste de resistencia|salvaguarda) de (forca|destreza|constituicao|inteligencia|sabedoria|carisma)/)?.[1]; const dmg = spellDamage(s, c.level); return { key: `spell:${s.id}`, section: s.level === 0 ? 'truque' : sectionOf(cost), name: s.name, cost, costLabel: asSlot(cost) ? ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost] : s.castingTime, source: s.level === 0 ? 'Truque' : `Magia de ${s.level}º círculo`, summary: firstSentence(s.description), stats: [ s.range, s.duration, ...(dmg ? [`${dmg.label} ${dmg.expr}`] : []), ...(save && spell ? [`CD ${spell.dc} ${SAVE_ABBR[save]}`] : []), ...(s.concentration && !/concentra/i.test(s.duration) ? ['Concentração'] : []), ], entry: { kind: 'spell', id: s.id }, attack: hasAttack && spell ? { label: `Ataque de ${s.name}`, bonus: spell.attack } : undefined, damage: dmg ? [dmg] : [], spell: s, }; }

nodes.name: buildActionCards
nodes.body_text: function buildActionCards(c: Character): ActionCard[] { const sheet = getSheet(c); const cards: ActionCard[] = []; // Ordem das seções: o que é do personagem primeiro; regras básicas no fim. (c.equipment ?? []).forEach((it, i) => { const l = lookupItem(it.name); if (l?.kind === 'weapon') cards.push(weaponCard(c, sheet, l.weapon, it.attack ?? 0, `weapon:${i}:${l.weapon.name}`)); }); const pushTrait = (key: string, name: string, description: string, source: string, entry: EntryRef) => { const cost = featureActionCost(description, name); if (cost === 'passivo') return; cards.push({ key, section: sectionOf(cost), name, cost, costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost], source, summary: SUMMARY_OVERRIDES[name] ?? firstSentence(description), stats: [], entry, damage: [], }); }; const cls = getClass(sheet.classId); const sub = cls?.subclasses.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subclassId); for (const f of cls?.features ?? []) { if (f.level <= c.level) pushTrait(`feature:${f.name}`, f.name, f.description, cls!.name, { kind: 'feature', classId: sheet.classId, name: f.name }); } for (const f of sub?.features ?? []) { if (f.level <= c.level) pushTrait(`feature:${sub!.id}:${f.name}`, f.name, f.description, sub!.name, { kind: 'feature', classId: sheet.classId, subclassId: sub!.id, name: f.name }); } const race = getRace(sheet.raceId); const subrace = race?.subraces.find((s) => s.id === sheet.subraceId); for (const t of race?.traits ?? []) pushTrait(`trait:${t.name}`, t.name, t.description, race!.name, { kind: 'trait', raceId: race!.id, name: t.name }); for (const t of subrace?.traits ?? []) pushTrait(`trait:${subrace!.id}:${t.name}`, t.name, t.description, subrace!.name, { kind: 'trait', raceId: race!.id, subraceId: subrace!.id, name: t.name }); const bg = getBackground(sheet.backgroundId); if (bg) pushTrait(`background:${bg.id}`, bg.feature.name, bg.feature.description, bg.name, { kind: 'background', id: bg.id }); const prepares = activeSpellcasting(sheet, c.level)?.preparesSpells; for (const id of sheet.spellsKnown) { const s = getSpell(id); if (s && (s.level === 0 || !prepares || sheet.spellsPrepared.includes(id))) cards.push(spellCard(c, s)); } for (const a of COMBAT_ACTIONS) { cards.push({ key: `action:${a.id}`, section: sectionOf(a.cost), name: a.name, cost: a.cost, costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL[a.cost], source: 'Regra básica', summary: a.summary, stats: [], entry: { kind: 'action', id: a.id }, damage: [], }); } return cards; }

nodes.name: pushTrait

nodes.body_text: pushTrait = (key: string, name: string, description: string, source: string, entry: EntryRef) => { const cost = featureActionCost(description, name); if (cost === 'passivo') return; cards.push({ key, section: sectionOf(cost), name, cost, costLabel: ACTION_COST_LABEL[cost], source, summary: SUMMARY_OVERRIDES[name] ?? firstSentence(description), stats: [], entry, damage: [], }); }

nodes.body_text: cardMatches = (card: ActionCard, q: string) => !q || normalizeText(`${card.name} ${card.source} ${card.summary} ${card.costLabel} ${card.stats.join(' ')}`).includes(q)

nodes.body_text: function attackDisadvantage(sheet: SheetData): string[] { const names: [string, string][] = [['envenenado', 'Envenenado'], ['amedrontado', 'Amedrontado'], ['cego', 'Cego'], ['caido', 'Caído'], ['impedido', 'Impedido']]; return [ ...(sheet.exhaustion >= 3 ? [`Exaustão ${sheet.exhaustion}`] : []), ...names.filter(([id]) => sheet.conditions.includes(id)).map(([, n]) => n), ]; }

nodes.name: lowestSlot
nodes.signature: function lowestSlot(spellLevel: number, slots: number[], used: number[]): number | null
nodes.body_text: function lowestSlot(spellLevel: number, slots: number[], used: number[]): number | null { for (let lvl = spellLevel; lvl <= slots.length; lvl++) { const total = slots[lvl - 1] ?? 0; if (total > (used[lvl - 1] ?? 0)) return lvl; } return null; }

nodes.body_text: // Autoverificação da busca. Rodar a partir de apps/web: npx tsx lib/search/engine.check.ts import assert from 'node:assert/strict'; import * as rules from '@repo/rules'; import { boundedDistance, buildRulesCorpus, composeIndex, parseQuery, removeFilterTokens, search, snippetFor, stem } from './index'; const built = performance.now(); const corpus = buildRulesCorpus(rules); const index = composeIndex(corpus, []); console.log(`índice: ${index.docs.length} documentos em ${Math.round(performance.now() - built)}ms`); // Normalização e distância assert.equal(stem('magias'), stem('magia')); assert.equal(stem('acoes'), stem('acao')); assert.equal(stem('maos'), stem('mao')); assert.equal(boundedDistance('fgo', 'fogo', 1), 1); assert.equal(boundedDistance('bolo', 'bloo', 1), 1); // transposição assert.ok(boundedDistance('mago', 'bruxo', 2) > 2); // Filtros assert.deepEqual(keysOf('truque fogo mago'), ['class:mago', 'damage:flamejante', 'level:0']); has('truque fogo mago', 'Raio de Fogo'); for (const r of search(index, 'truque fogo mago').results) { assert.equal(r.doc.facets?.spellLevel, 0, r.doc.title); assert.ok(r.doc.facets?.classes?.includes('mago'), r.doc.title); } assert.deepEqual(keysOf('reação ladino'), ['class:ladino', 'cost:reacao']); has('reação ladino', 'Esquiva Sobrenatural'); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('magia de cura 1 círculo'), ['heal', 'level:1', 'spell']); has('magia de cura 1 círculo', 'Curar Ferimentos'); assert.ok(search(index, 'magia de cura 1 círculo').results.every((r) => r.doc.facets?.spellLevel === 1)); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('acao bonus'), ['cost:bonus']); has('acao bonus', 'Ação Ardilosa'); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('concentracao ilusao'), ['concentration', 'school:Ilusão']); assert.ok(search(index, 'concentracao ilusao').results.every((r) => r.doc.facets?.school === 'Ilusão' && r.doc.facets?.concentration)); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('3º círculo'), ['level:3']); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('círculo 2 ritual'), ['level:2', 'ritual']); // Nomes têm prioridade sobre filtros assert.equal(top('bola de fogo'), 'Bola de Fogo'); assert.deepEqual(keysOf('bola de fogo'), []); assert.equal(top('raio de gelo'), 'Raio de Gelo'); assert.equal(top('raio de fogo'), 'Raio de Fogo'); // Erros de digitação, apelidos e prefixos assert.equal(top('bola de fgo'), 'Bola de Fogo'); assert.equal(top('desengajr'), 'Desengajar'); assert.equal(top('fireball'), 'Bola de Fogo'); assert.equal(top('borrifo venenoso'), 'Rajada de Veneno'); assert.equal(top('bola de f'), 'Bola de Fogo'); // Tudo mais assert.equal(top('ataque furtivo'), 'Ataque Furtivo'); assert.equal(top('besta de mao'), 'Besta de Mão'); assert.equal(top('envenenado'), 'Envenenado'); assert.equal(top('o que faz desengajar'), 'Desengajar'); assert.equal(top('MÃOS MÁGICAS'), 'Mãos Mágicas'); assert.equal(top('trapaceiro arcano'), 'Trapaceiro Arcano'); // Filtro sem resultado volta a ser texto livre assert.deepEqual(search(index, 'ladino paladino').filters, []); // Remover chip tira as palavras do campo const parsed = parseQuery('truque de fogo mago', index.vocab); const fire = parsed.filters.find((f) => f.key === 'damage:flamejante')!; assert.equal(removeFilterTokens(parsed.rawTokens, fire), 'truque de mago'); // Trecho const body = search(index, 'flamejante').results.find((r) => r.inBody); if (body) assert.ok(snippetFor(body.doc, ['flamejante'])?.toLowerCase().includes('flamejante')); // Ordem determinística assert.deepEqual(titles('truque'), titles('truque')); // Desempenho const queries = ['truque fogo mago', 'reação ladino', 'bola de fgo', 'concentracao ilusao', 'o que faz desengajar', 'teleportacao', 'magia de cura 1 círculo']; for (const q of queries) { const t0 = performance.now(); for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) search(index, q); const ms = (performance.now() - t0) / 5; console.log(` ${q}: ${ms.toFixed(1)}ms, ${search(index, q).results.length} resultados`); assert.ok(ms < 30, `${q} levou ${ms.toFixed(1)}ms`); } console.log('ok');

nodes.name: titles
nodes.body_text: titles = (q: string) => search(index, q).results.map((r) => r.doc.title)

nodes.name: top
nodes.body_text: top = (q: string) => titles(q)[0]

nodes.name: has
nodes.body_text: has = (q: string, title: string) => assert.ok(titles(q).includes(title), `"${q}" deveria trazer ${title}; veio: ${titles(q).slice(0, 8).join(', ')}`)

nodes.name: keysOf
nodes.body_text: keysOf = (q: string) => search(index, q).filters.map((f) => f.key).sort()

nodes.name: engine.ts
nodes.body_text: // Motor de busca: puro, sem React e sem depender de @repo/rules em tempo de execução. // Entende filtros em português ("truque fogo mago"), tolera erros de digitação e pesa os campos // na ordem título > apelidos > tags > corpo. import type { ActionCost } from '@repo/rules'; import type { EntryRef } from '@/components/entries/types'; /** Atributos usados pelos filtros. Ausente = o filtro correspondente reprova o documento. */ /* ---------- Normalização ---------- */ /** Stemming leve: o suficiente para singular e plural em português. */ /** Distância Damerau-Levenshtein com limite: devolve max + 1 ao passar do limite. */ /* ---------- Vocabulário de filtros ---------- */ export const DAMAGE_TYPES: { id: string; label: string; words: string[]; re: RegExp }[] = [ { id: 'flamejante', label: 'Fogo', words: ['fogo', 'flamejante', 'flamejantes', 'chamas'], re: /dano (de )?(flamejante|fogo)/ }, { id: 'congelante', label: 'Frio', words: ['gelo', 'frio', 'congelante', 'congelantes'], re: /dano (de )?(congelante|frio|gelo)/ }, { id: 'venenoso', label: 'Veneno', words: ['veneno', 'venenoso', 'venenosa'], re: /dano (de )?(venenoso|veneno)/ }, { id: 'acido', label: 'Ácido', words: ['acido', 'acida'], re: /dano (de )?acido/ }, { id: 'eletrico', label: 'Elétrico', words: ['raio', 'raios', 'eletrico', 'eletrica', 'eletricidade', 'relampago'], re: /dano (de )?(eletrico|eletricidade|relampago)/ }, { id: 'trovejante', label: 'Trovão', words: ['trovao', 'trovejante'], re: /dano (de )?(trovejante|trovao)/ }, { id: 'necrotico', label: 'Necrótico', words: ['necrotico', 'necrotica'], re: /dano (de )?necrotico/ }, { id: 'radiante', label: 'Radiante', words: ['radiante'], re: /dano (de )?radiante/ }, { id: 'psiquico', label: 'Psíquico', words: ['psiquico', 'psiquica'], re: /dano (de )?psiquico/ }, { id: 'forca', label: 'Força', words: ['forca', 'energia'], re: /dano (de )?(forca|energia)/ }, { id: 'cortante', label: 'Cortante', words: ['cortante'], re: /dano (de )?cortante|\bcortante\b/ }, { id: 'perfurante', label: 'Perfurante', words: ['perfurante'], re: /dano (de )?perfurante|\bperfurante\b/ }, { id: 'concussao', label: 'Concussão', words: ['concussao', 'contundente'], re: /dano (de )?(concussao|contundente)|\bconcussao\b/ }, ]; const DAMAGE_BY_WORD = new Map(DAMAGE_TYPES.flatMap((d) => d.words.map((w) => [w, d] as const))); const HEAL_RE = /recuper\w*[^.]{0,80}pontos de vida|\bcura(r|m)?\b/; /** Tipos de dano e cura citados em um texto já normalizado. */ const SCHOOLS = new Map( ['Abjuração', 'Conjuração', 'Adivinhação', 'Encantamento', 'Evocação', 'Ilusão', 'Necromancia', 'Transmutação'] .map((s) => [norm(s), s] as const), ); const COST_LABEL: Record<string, string> = { acao: 'Ação', bonus: 'Ação bônus', reacao: 'Reação' }; const STOP_WORDS = new Set([ 'o', 'a', 'os', 'as', 'um', 'uma', 'de', 'do', 'da', 'dos', 'das', 'e', 'em', 'no', 'na', 'nos', 'nas', 'ao', 'aos', 'que', 'faz', 'fazem', 'como', 'qual', 'quais', 'funciona', 'para', 'pra', 'com', 'por', 'se', 'sobre', 'meu', 'minha', 'tem', ]); /** Busca sem as palavras de um filtro: é o que remover o chip faz com o campo. */ /* ---------- Índice ---------- */ /* ---------- Pontuação ---------- */ const Field = { Title: 0, Alias: 1, Tag: 2, Body: 3 } as const; const collator = new Intl.Collator('pt-BR'); /** Documento cujo título ou apelido contém todas as palavras digitadas. */ /** Trecho do corpo em volta da primeira palavra encontrada. */

nodes.name: SearchGroup
nodes.body_text: type SearchGroup = | 'Páginas' | 'Fichas' | 'Magias' | 'Características' | 'Classes' | 'Raças' | 'Antecedentes' | 'Equipamento' | 'Regras';

nodes.name: DocFacets
nodes.body_text: interface DocFacets { spellLevel?: number; featureLevel?: number; classes?: string[]; school?: string; cost?: ActionCost; concentration?: boolean; ritual?: boolean; damage?: string[]; heals?: boolean; dealsDamage?: boolean; }

nodes.name: DocTarget
nodes.signature: type DocTarget = { entry: EntryRef } | { href: string };
nodes.body_text: type DocTarget = { entry: EntryRef } | { href: string };

nodes.name: DocInput
nodes.body_text: interface DocInput { key: string; group: SearchGroup; title: string; sub?: string; aliases?: string[]; tags?: string[]; body?: string; facets?: DocFacets; target: DocTarget; }

nodes.name: SearchDoc
nodes.body_text: interface SearchDoc extends DocInput { titleNorm: string; titleTokens: string[]; titleStems: Set<string>; aliasNorms: string[]; aliasTokens: string[]; aliasStems: Set<string>; tagTokens: string[]; tagStems: Set<string>; bodyNorm: string; bodyStems: Set<string>; }

nodes.name: SearchVocab
nodes.body_text: interface SearchVocab { /** Nome normalizado da classe -> id. */ classes: Map<string, { id: string; label: string }>; }

nodes.name: SearchIndex
nodes.body_text: interface SearchIndex { docs: SearchDoc[]; vocab: SearchVocab; /** Tokens de título e apelido, sem repetição (base da busca aproximada). */ fuzzyVocab: string[]; }

nodes.name: QueryFilter
nodes.signature: type QueryFilter = | { type: 'level'; value: number; spellOnly: boolean } | { type: 'class'; value: string } | { type: 'school'; value: string } | { type: 'cost'; value: ActionCost } | { type: 'concentration' } | { type: 'ritual' } | { type: 'damage'; value: string } | { type: 'heal' } | { type: 'deals' } | { type: 'spell' };
nodes.body_text: type QueryFilter = | { type: 'level'; value: number; spellOnly: boolean } | { type: 'class'; value: string } | { type: 'school'; value: string } | { type: 'cost'; value: ActionCost } | { type: 'concentration' } | { type: 'ritual' } | { type: 'damage'; value: string } | { type: 'heal' } | { type: 'deals' } | { type: 'spell' };

nodes.name: ActiveFilter
nodes.body_text: interface ActiveFilter { key: string; label: string; filter: QueryFilter; /** Posições das palavras da busca que geraram o filtro (para removê-las do campo). */ tokenIdx: number[]; }

nodes.name: ParsedQuery
nodes.body_text: interface ParsedQuery { rawTokens: string[]; filters: ActiveFilter[]; /** Palavras livres, sem as que viraram filtro. */ terms: string[]; /** Todas as palavras úteis, inclusive as que viraram filtro. */ literalTerms: string[]; /** Busca normalizada sem palavras vazias no início. */ phrase: string; }

nodes.name: SearchResult
nodes.body_text: interface SearchResult { doc: SearchDoc; score: number; /** A correspondência veio só do corpo do texto. */ inBody: boolean; }

nodes.name: SearchOutcome
nodes.body_text: interface SearchOutcome { results: SearchResult[]; filters: ActiveFilter[]; /** Termos usados, para destacar o texto. */ highlight: string[]; /** Nenhum documento tinha todas as palavras: mostra os que têm a maioria. */ relaxed: boolean; }

nodes.name: norm
nodes.body_text: norm = (s: string) => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase()

nodes.name: tokenize
nodes.body_text: tokenize = (s: string) => norm(s).split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter(Boolean)

nodes.name: stem
nodes.body_text: function stem(t: string): string { if (t.length <= 3) return t; if (t.endsWith('coes')) return `${t.slice(0, -4)}cao`; if (t.endsWith('oes') || t.endsWith('aes')) return `${t.slice(0, -3)}ao`; if (t.length > 4 && t.endsWith('ais')) return `${t.slice(0, -3)}al`; if (t.length > 4 && t.endsWith('eis')) return `${t.slice(0, -3)}el`; if (t.endsWith('ns')) return `${t.slice(0, -2)}m`; if (t.length > 4 && (t.endsWith('res') || t.endsWith('zes'))) return t.slice(0, -2); if (t.endsWith('s') && !t.endsWith('ss')) return t.slice(0, -1); return t; }

nodes.name: boundedDistance
nodes.signature: function boundedDistance(a: string, b: string, max: number): number
nodes.body_text: function boundedDistance(a: string, b: string, max: number): number { if (Math.abs(a.length - b.length) > max) return max + 1; let prev2: number[] = []; let prev = Array.from({ length: b.length + 1 }, (_, j) => j); for (let i = 1; i <= a.length; i++) { const cur = [i]; let best = i; for (let j = 1; j <= b.length; j++) { const cost = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1; let v = Math.min(prev[j]! + 1, cur[j - 1]! + 1, prev[j - 1]! + cost); if (i > 1 && j > 1 && a[i - 1] === b[j - 2] && a[i - 2] === b[j - 1]) v = Math.min(v, prev2[j - 2]! + 1); cur[j] = v; if (v < best) best = v; } if (best > max) return max + 1; prev2 = prev; prev = cur; } return prev[b.length]!; }

nodes.name: damageIn
nodes.body_text: damageIn = (bodyNorm: string) => DAMAGE_TYPES.filter((d) => d.re.test(bodyNorm)).map((d) => d.id)

nodes.name: healsIn
nodes.body_text: healsIn = (bodyNorm: string) => HEAL_RE.test(bodyNorm)

nodes.name: numberOf
nodes.body_text: numberOf = (t: string) => { const m = t.match(/^(\d)[oa]?$/); return m ? Number(m[1]) : null; }

nodes.name: isLevelWord
nodes.body_text: isLevelWord = (t: string) => t === 'circulo' || t === 'circulos' || t === 'nivel' || t === 'niveis'

nodes.name: isSpellLevelWord
nodes.body_text: isSpellLevelWord = (t: string) => t === 'circulo' || t === 'circulos'

nodes.name: parseQuery
nodes.signature: function parseQuery(raw: string, vocab: SearchVocab): ParsedQuery
nodes.body_text: function parseQuery(raw: string, vocab: SearchVocab): ParsedQuery { const rawTokens = raw.trim().split(/\s+/).filter(Boolean); const toks = rawTokens.map((t) => tokenize(t).join('')); const filters: ActiveFilter[] = []; const terms: string[] = []; const used = new Set<number>(); const add = (key: string, label: string, filter: QueryFilter, ...tokenIdx: number[]) => { tokenIdx.forEach((i) => used.add(i)); if (!filters.some((f) => f.key === key)) filters.push({ key, label, filter, tokenIdx }); }; const levelLabel = (n: number, spellOnly: boolean) => (spellOnly || n > 0 ? (spellOnly ? `${n}º círculo` : `Nível ${n}`) : 'Truque'); for (let i = 0; i < toks.length; i++) { if (used.has(i)) continue; const t = toks[i]!; const next = toks[i + 1] ?? ''; const n = numberOf(t); if (n !== null && isLevelWord(next)) { const spellOnly = isSpellLevelWord(next); add(`level:${n}`, levelLabel(n, spellOnly), { type: 'level', value: n, spellOnly }, i, i + 1); } else if (isLevelWord(t) && numberOf(next) !== null) { const v = numberOf(next)!; const spellOnly = isSpellLevelWord(t); add(`level:${v}`, levelLabel(v, spellOnly), { type: 'level', value: v, spellOnly }, i, i + 1); } else if ((t === 'acao' || t === 'acoes') && (next === 'bonus' || next === 'bônus')) { add('cost:bonus', COST_LABEL.bonus!, { type: 'cost', value: 'bonus' }, i, i + 1); } else if (t === 'bonus') { add('cost:bonus', COST_LABEL.bonus!, { type: 'cost', value: 'bonus' }, i); } else if (t === 'acao' || t === 'acoes') { add('cost:acao', COST_LABEL.acao!, { type: 'cost', value: 'acao' }, i); } else if (t === 'reacao' || t === 'reacoes') { add('cost:reacao', COST_LABEL.reacao!, { type: 'cost', value: 'reacao' }, i); } else if (t === 'truque' || t === 'truques' || t === 'cantrip' || t === 'cantrips') { add('level:0', 'Truque', { type: 'level', value: 0, spellOnly: true }, i); } else if (t === 'magia' || t === 'magias' || t === 'feitico' || t === 'feiticos') { add('spell', 'Magias', { type: 'spell' }, i); } else if (t === 'concentracao' || t === 'concentrar') { add('concentration', 'Concentração', { type: 'concentration' }, i); } else if (t === 'ritual' || t === 'rituais') { add('ritual', 'Ritual', { type: 'ritual' }, i); } else if (t === 'cura' || t === 'curas' || t === 'curar' || t === 'curativa' || t === 'curativo') { add('heal', 'Cura', { type: 'heal' }, i); } else if (t === 'dano' || t === 'danos') { add('deals', 'Causa dano', { type: 'deals' }, i); } else if (SCHOOLS.has(t) || SCHOOLS.has(stem(t))) { const school = SCHOOLS.get(t) ?? SCHOOLS.get(stem(t))!; add(`school:${school}`, school, { type: 'school', value: school }, i); } else if (vocab.classes.has(t) || vocab.classes.has(stem(t))) { const c = vocab.classes.get(t) ?? vocab.classes.get(stem(t))!; add(`class:${c.id}`, c.label, { type: 'class', value: c.id }, i); } else if (DAMAGE_BY_WORD.has(t)) { const d = DAMAGE_BY_WORD.get(t)!; add(`damage:${d.id}`, `Dano: ${d.label}`, { type: 'damage', value: d.id }, i); } else if (t && !STOP_WORDS.has(t)) { terms.push(t); } } const literalTerms = toks.flatMap((t) => (t && !STOP_WORDS.has(t) ? [t] : [])); let first = 0; while (first < toks.length && STOP_WORDS.has(toks[first]!)) first++; return { rawTokens, filters, terms, literalTerms, phrase: toks.slice(first).filter(Boolean).join(' ') }; }

nodes.name: add
nodes.signature: add = (key: string, label: string, filter: QueryFilter, ...tokenIdx: number[])
nodes.body_text: add = (key: string, label: string, filter: QueryFilter, ...tokenIdx: number[]) => { tokenIdx.forEach((i) => used.add(i)); if (!filters.some((f) => f.key === key)) filters.push({ key, label, filter, tokenIdx }); }

nodes.name: levelLabel
nodes.body_text: levelLabel = (n: number, spellOnly: boolean) => (spellOnly || n > 0 ? (spellOnly ? `${n}º círculo` : `Nível ${n}`) : 'Truque')

nodes.name: removeFilterTokens
nodes.signature: function removeFilterTokens(rawTokens: string[], f: Pick<ActiveFilter, 'tokenIdx'>): string
nodes.body_text: function removeFilterTokens(rawTokens: string[], f: Pick<ActiveFilter, 'tokenIdx'>): string { return rawTokens.filter((_, i) => !f.tokenIdx.includes(i)).join(' '); }

nodes.name: passes
nodes.signature: function passes(doc: SearchDoc, { filter: f }: ActiveFilter): boolean
nodes.body_text: function passes(doc: SearchDoc, { filter: f }: ActiveFilter): boolean { const x = doc.facets; if (!x) return false; switch (f.type) { case 'level': return x.spellLevel === f.value || (!f.spellOnly && x.featureLevel === f.value); case 'class': return !!x.classes?.includes(f.value); case 'school': return x.school === f.value; case 'cost': return x.cost === f.value; case 'concentration': return !!x.concentration; case 'ritual': return !!x.ritual; case 'damage': return !!x.damage?.includes(f.value); case 'heal': return !!x.heals; case 'deals': return !!x.dealsDamage; case 'spell': return x.spellLevel !== undefined; } }

nodes.name: prepareDoc
nodes.body_text: function prepareDoc(d: DocInput): SearchDoc { const titleTokens = tokenize(d.title); const aliases = d.aliases ?? []; const aliasTokens = aliases.flatMap(tokenize); const tagTokens = (d.tags ?? []).flatMap(tokenize); const bodyNorm = ` ${norm(d.body ?? '')} `; return { ...d, titleNorm: titleTokens.join(' '), titleTokens, titleStems: new Set(titleTokens.map(stem)), aliasNorms: aliases.map((a) => tokenize(a).join(' ')), aliasTokens, aliasStems: new Set(aliasTokens.map(stem)), tagTokens, tagStems: new Set(tagTokens.map(stem)), bodyNorm, bodyStems: new Set(bodyNorm.split(/[^a-z0-9]+/).filter((t) => t.length > 1).map(stem)), }; }

nodes.name: createIndex
nodes.signature: function createIndex(docs: SearchDoc[], vocab: SearchVocab): SearchIndex
nodes.body_text: function createIndex(docs: SearchDoc[], vocab: SearchVocab): SearchIndex { const set = new Set<string>(); for (const d of docs) { for (const t of d.titleTokens) set.add(t); for (const t of d.aliasTokens) set.add(t); } return { docs, vocab, fuzzyVocab: [...set] }; }

nodes.name: Field
nodes.body_text: type Field = (typeof Field)[keyof typeof Field];

nodes.name: Term
nodes.body_text: interface Term { raw: string; stem: string; /** Token do vocabulário -> distância. */ fuzzy: Map<string, number>; }

nodes.name: TermHit
nodes.body_text: interface TermHit { score: number; field: Field; fuzzy: boolean }

nodes.name: fuzzyBudget
nodes.signature: function fuzzyBudget(len: number, multiTerm: boolean): number
nodes.body_text: function fuzzyBudget(len: number, multiTerm: boolean): number { if (len >= 8) return 2; if (len >= 4) return 1; // Três letras só com contexto: "bola de fgo" sim; "fgo" sozinho traria ruído demais. return len === 3 && multiTerm ? 1 : 0; }

nodes.name: makeTerm
nodes.signature: function makeTerm(raw: string, vocab: string[], multiTerm: boolean): Term
nodes.body_text: function makeTerm(raw: string, vocab: string[], multiTerm: boolean): Term { const budget = fuzzyBudget(raw.length, multiTerm); const fuzzy = new Map<string, number>(); if (budget > 0) { for (const v of vocab) { if (v === raw || Math.abs(v.length - raw.length) > budget) continue; // O primeiro caractere raramente erra; só palavras longas relaxam essa regra. if (v[0] !== raw[0] && raw.length < 5) continue; if (v.length < 3) continue; const dist = boundedDistance(raw, v, budget); if (dist <= budget) fuzzy.set(v, dist); } } return { raw, stem: stem(raw), fuzzy }; }

nodes.name: matchIn
nodes.signature: function matchIn(tokens: string[], stems: Set<string>, t: Term, exact: number, prefix: number, minPrefix: number): number
nodes.body_text: function matchIn(tokens: string[], stems: Set<string>, t: Term, exact: number, prefix: number, minPrefix: number): number { if (tokens.includes(t.raw) || stems.has(t.stem)) return exact; if (t.raw.length >= minPrefix && tokens.some((x) => x.startsWith(t.raw))) return prefix; return 0; }

nodes.name: bestFuzzy
nodes.signature: function bestFuzzy(tokens: string[], t: Term): number | undefined
nodes.body_text: function bestFuzzy(tokens: string[], t: Term): number | undefined { let best: number | undefined; for (const x of tokens) { const d = t.fuzzy.get(x); if (d !== undefined && (best === undefined || d < best)) best = d; } return best; }

nodes.name: matchTerm
nodes.signature: function matchTerm(doc: SearchDoc, t: Term): TermHit | null
nodes.body_text: function matchTerm(doc: SearchDoc, t: Term): TermHit | null { let s = matchIn(doc.titleTokens, doc.titleStems, t, 100, 70, 1); if (s) return { score: s, field: Field.Title, fuzzy: false }; s = matchIn(doc.aliasTokens, doc.aliasStems, t, 60, 45, 2); if (s) return { score: s, field: Field.Alias, fuzzy: false }; s = matchIn(doc.tagTokens, doc.tagStems, t, 35, 25, 3); if (s) return { score: s, field: Field.Tag, fuzzy: false }; if (t.fuzzy.size) { const dt = bestFuzzy(doc.titleTokens, t); if (dt !== undefined) return { score: 32 - dt * 4, field: Field.Title, fuzzy: true }; const da = bestFuzzy(doc.aliasTokens, t); if (da !== undefined) return { score: 20 - da * 3, field: Field.Alias, fuzzy: true }; } if (doc.bodyStems.has(t.stem)) return { score: 12, field: Field.Body, fuzzy: false }; if (t.raw.length >= 4 && doc.bodyNorm.includes(` ${t.raw}`)) return { score: 8, field: Field.Body, fuzzy: false }; return null; }

nodes.name: byRank
nodes.body_text: byRank = (a: SearchResult, b: SearchResult) => b.score - a.score || collator.compare(a.doc.title, b.doc.title) || a.doc.key.localeCompare(b.doc.key)

nodes.name: hasPhrase
nodes.body_text: hasPhrase = (hay: string, phrase: string) => ` ${hay} `.includes(` ${phrase} `)

nodes.name: phraseBonus
nodes.signature: function phraseBonus(doc: SearchDoc, phrase: string): number
nodes.body_text: function phraseBonus(doc: SearchDoc, phrase: string): number { if (!phrase) return 0; if (doc.titleNorm === phrase) return 1000; if (doc.aliasNorms.includes(phrase)) return 600; if (doc.titleNorm.startsWith(`${phrase} `)) return 400; if (hasPhrase(doc.titleNorm, phrase)) return 200; if (phrase.length >= 2 && doc.titleNorm.startsWith(phrase)) return 120; if (doc.aliasNorms.some((a) => hasPhrase(a, phrase))) return 100; return 0; }

nodes.name: isLiteralTitle
nodes.signature: function isLiteralTitle(doc: SearchDoc, terms: Term[]): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isLiteralTitle(doc: SearchDoc, terms: Term[]): boolean { return terms.length > 0 && terms.every((t) => { const hit = matchTerm(doc, t); return !!hit && (hit.field === Field.Title || hit.field === Field.Alias); }); }

nodes.name: RunOptions
nodes.body_text: interface RunOptions { filters: ActiveFilter[]; terms: Term[]; literal: Term[]; phrase: string; minMatches?: number }

nodes.name: run
nodes.signature: function run(index: SearchIndex, o: RunOptions): { results: SearchResult[]; passed: number }
nodes.body_text: function run(index: SearchIndex, o: RunOptions): { results: SearchResult[]; passed: number } { const out: { r: SearchResult; fuzzy: boolean; strong: boolean }[] = []; let passed = 0; for (const doc of index.docs) { const passFilters = o.filters.every((f) => passes(doc, f)); let score = 0; let matched = 0; let usedFuzzy = false; let shortFuzzy = false; let exactTitle = false; let inBody = false; if (passFilters) { for (const t of o.terms) { const hit = matchTerm(doc, t); if (!hit) continue; matched++; score += hit.score; if (hit.fuzzy) { usedFuzzy = true; if (t.raw.length === 3) shortFuzzy = true; } else if (hit.field === Field.Title) exactTitle = true; if (hit.field === Field.Body) inBody = true; } } const need = o.minMatches ?? o.terms.length; let ok = passFilters && matched >= need && !(shortFuzzy && !exactTitle); if (ok && o.filters.length) passed++; const literal = o.filters.length > 0 && isLiteralTitle(doc, o.literal); if (literal) { score += 300; ok = true; inBody = false; } if (!ok) continue; score += phraseBonus(doc, o.phrase); out.push({ r: { doc, score, inBody }, fuzzy: usedFuzzy, strong: !usedFuzzy && (exactTitle || literal) }); } // Com acerto real no título, os aproximados só atrapalham. const anyStrong = out.some((x) => x.strong); const kept = anyStrong ? out.filter((x) => !x.fuzzy) : out; return { results: kept.map((x) => x.r).sort(byRank), passed }; }

nodes.name: search
nodes.signature: function search(index: SearchIndex, raw: string): SearchOutcome
nodes.body_text: function search(index: SearchIndex, raw: string): SearchOutcome { const p = parseQuery(raw, index.vocab); if (!p.literalTerms.length) return { results: [], filters: [], highlight: [], relaxed: false }; const multi = p.literalTerms.length > 1; const literal = p.literalTerms.map((t) => makeTerm(t, index.fuzzyVocab, multi)); const highlightOf = (terms: string[]) => [...new Set(terms.flatMap((t) => [t, stem(t)]))]; const free = () => run(index, { filters: [], terms: literal, literal, phrase: p.phrase }); let filters = p.filters; // "Bola de Fogo" é o nome de uma magia, mesmo com "fogo" sendo também um filtro. if (filters.length && p.terms.length && index.docs.some((d) => hasPhrase(d.titleNorm, p.phrase) || d.aliasNorms.some((a) => hasPhrase(a, p.phrase)))) { filters = []; } let results: SearchResult[]; if (filters.length) { const terms = p.terms.map((t) => makeTerm(t, index.fuzzyVocab, multi)); const r = run(index, { filters, terms, literal, phrase: p.phrase }); if (r.passed > 0) return { results: r.results, filters, highlight: highlightOf(p.literalTerms), relaxed: false }; // Filtro não fez sentido: as palavras voltam a ser texto livre. filters = []; results = free().results; } else { results = free().results; } if (results.length || literal.length < 2) return { results, filters: [], highlight: highlightOf(p.literalTerms), relaxed: false }; const relaxed = run(index, { filters: [], terms: literal, literal, phrase: p.phrase, minMatches: Math.ceil(literal.length / 2) }); return { results: relaxed.results, filters: [], highlight: highlightOf(p.literalTerms), relaxed: true }; }

nodes.name: highlightOf
nodes.body_text: highlightOf = (terms: string[]) => [...new Set(terms.flatMap((t) => [t, stem(t)]))]

nodes.name: free
nodes.body_text: free = () => run(index, { filters: [], terms: literal, literal, phrase: p.phrase })

nodes.name: snippetFor
nodes.signature: function snippetFor(doc: Pick<SearchDoc, 'body' | 'bodyNorm'>, terms: string[], width = 110): string | undefined
nodes.body_text: function snippetFor(doc: Pick<SearchDoc, 'body' | 'bodyNorm'>, terms: string[], width = 110): string | undefined { if (!doc.body) return undefined; let at = -1; for (const t of terms) { if (t.length < 2) continue; const i = doc.bodyNorm.indexOf(` ${t}`); if (i >= 0 && (at < 0 || i < at)) at = i; } if (at < 0) return undefined; // bodyNorm tem um espaço a mais no início, e o índice aponta para o espaço antes da palavra. const source = doc.body.length === doc.bodyNorm.length - 2 ? doc.body : doc.bodyNorm.trim(); const start = Math.max(0, at - 30); const end = Math.min(source.length, start + width); return `${start > 0 ? '…' : ''}${source.slice(start, end).replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim()}${end < source.length ? '…' : ''}`; }

nodes.name: buildRulesCorpus
nodes.body_text: function buildRulesCorpus(r: Rules): RulesCorpus { const classes: SearchVocab['classes'] = new Map(r.CLASSES.map((c) => [norm(c.name), { id: c.id, label: c.name }])); const guardiao = r.CLASSES.find((c) => c.id === 'guardiao'); if (guardiao) classes.set('patrulheiro', { id: guardiao.id, label: guardiao.name }); return { docs: ruleDocs(r).map(prepareDoc), vocab: { classes } }; }

nodes.name: spellActionCost
nodes.body_text: function spellActionCost(spell: Pick<Spell, "castingTime">): ActionCost { const t = norm(spell.castingTime); if (t.includes("bonus")) return "bonus"; if (t.includes("reacao")) return "reacao"; if (/\b1 acao\b/.test(t) || t === "acao") return "acao"; return "outro"; }

nodes.body_text: function featureActionCost(description: string, name?: string): ActionCost { const override = name ? FEATURE_COST_OVERRIDES[name] : undefined; if (override) return override; const t = norm(description); if (/(usar|use|usando|gastar|gasta) (a |sua |uma )?reacao|como (uma )?reacao|com (a |sua |uma )?reacao/.test(t)) return "reacao"; if (/(usar|use|usando|gastar|gasta) (a |sua |uma )?acao bonus|como (uma )?acao bonus|com (a |sua |uma )?acao bonus/.test(t)) return "bonus"; if (/(usar|use|usando|gastar) (a |sua |uma )?acao\b(?! de)|como (uma )?acao\b(?! de)|com (a |sua |uma )acao\b(?! de)/.test(t)) return "acao"; return "passivo"; }

nodes.body_text: async function main() { console.log("Iniciando seed..."); const users = {} as Record<string, { id: string; username: string }>; for (const [username, role] of [ ["mestre", UserRole.MASTER], ["jogador1", UserRole.PLAYER], ["jogador2", UserRole.PLAYER], ] as const) { users[username] = await prisma.user.upsert({ where: { username }, update: {}, create: { username, role } }); } console.log(`Usuários: ${Object.keys(users).join(", ")}`); for (const c of buildCharacters()) { const owner = users[c.owner]!; // update refaz a ficha a partir das regras, mantendo ids fixos await prisma.character.upsert({ where: { id: c.id }, update: { ...c.data, userId: owner.id }, create: { id: c.id, userId: owner.id, ...c.data }, }); console.log(` ${c.data.name} - ${c.data.race} ${c.data.class} (Nível ${c.data.level}) -> ${c.owner}`); } console.log("Seed concluído."); }

"MASTER" : "PLAYER", }, }); } return res.json({ user }); } catch (error) { console.error("Erro na autenticação:", error); return res.status(500).json({ error: "Erro ao autenticar usuário" }); } }); // GET - Buscar usuário por username router.get("/", async (req: Request, res: Response) => { try { const { username } = req.query; if (!username || typeof username !== "string") { return res.status(400).json({ error: "Username é obrigatório" }); } const user = await prisma.user.findUnique({ where: { username }, include: { characters: true, }, }); if (!user) { return res.status(404).json({ error: "Usuário não encontrado" }); } return res.json({ user }); } catch (error) { console.error("Erro ao buscar usuário:", error); return res.status(500).json({ error: "Erro ao buscar usuário" }); } }); export default router;

nodes.body_text: import { ARMOR, GEAR, WEAPONS, abilityModifier, proficiencyBonus, type ArmorItem, type ClassDef, type Weapon } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character, Equipment } from '@/lib/api'; import type { Coins } from '@/lib/sheet'; /* ---------- Busca nas tabelas de regras ---------- */ /** "6,5 kg" -> 6.5; "—" -> undefined. */ /* ---------- Equipar ---------- */ /** * Dados antigos não têm o campo `equipped`: se nenhum item o define, tudo conta como equipado. * Assim a CA calculada de fichas existentes não muda até o jogador usar os botões de equipar. */ /** Alterna `equipped` do item i; só uma armadura de corpo e um escudo por vez. */ /* ---------- Peso ---------- */ /** Regra variante (kg): sobrecarregado > For x 2,5; muito sobrecarregado > For x 5. */ /** 50 moedas = 0,5 kg. */ /* ---------- Moedas ---------- */ export const COIN_ORDER: CoinKey[] = ['pp', 'gp', 'ep', 'sp', 'cp']; export const COIN_LABEL: Record<CoinKey, string> = { pp: 'PL', gp: 'PO', ep: 'PE', sp: 'PP', cp: 'PC' }; export const COIN_NAME: Record<CoinKey, string> = { pp: 'Platina', gp: 'Ouro', ep: 'Electro', sp: 'Prata', cp: 'Cobre' }; const CP: Record<CoinKey, number> = { pp: 1000, gp: 100, ep: 50, sp: 10, cp: 1 }; /** Troca `amount` moedas de `from` pelo máximo possível de `to`. */ /* ---------- Proficiência e requisitos ---------- */ /* ---------- Ataques ---------- */ /** Dobra os dados (crítico) mantendo o bônus fixo. */ /* ---------- Avisos do equipamento em uso ---------- */

nodes.name: normName
nodes.body_text: normName = (s: string) => s.normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g, '').toLowerCase().replace(/\s*\(.*\)\s*$/, '').trim()

nodes.name: parseKg
nodes.signature: function parseKg(s: string | undefined): number | undefined
nodes.body_text: function parseKg(s: string | undefined): number | undefined { if (!s) return undefined; const m = s.match(/(\d+(?:[.,]\d+)?)\s*kg/i); return m ? Number(m[1]!.replace(',', '.')) : undefined; }

nodes.name: lookupItem
nodes.body_text: function lookupItem(name: string): Lookup | null { const n = normName(name); if (!n) return null; const armor = ARMOR.find((a) => normName(a.name) === n); if (armor) return { kind: 'armor', armor, weight: parseKg(armor.weight) }; const weapon = WEAPONS.find((w) => normName(w.name) === n); if (weapon) return { kind: 'weapon', weapon, weight: parseKg(weapon.weight) }; const gear = GEAR.find((g) => normName(g.name) === n); if (gear) return { kind: 'gear', weight: parseKg(gear.weight) }; return null; }

nodes.signature: function isEquipped(items: Equipment[], it: Equipment): boolean
nodes.body_text: function isEquipped(items: Equipment[], it: Equipment): boolean { if (it.equipped !== undefined) return it.equipped; return items.every((x) => x.equipped === undefined); }

nodes.name: toggleEquipped
nodes.signature: function toggleEquipped(items: Equipment[], i: number): Equipment[]
nodes.body_text: function toggleEquipped(items: Equipment[], i: number): Equipment[] { const target = items[i]; if (!target) return items; const on = !isEquipped(items, target); return items.map((x, j) => { const cur = isEquipped(items, x); if (j === i) return { ...x, equipped: on }; if (on && ((isBody(target) && isBody(x)) || (isShield(target) && isShield(x)))) return { ...x, equipped: false }; return { ...x, equipped: cur }; }); }

nodes.name: exchangeCoins
nodes.signature: function exchangeCoins(c: Coins, from: CoinKey, to: CoinKey, amount: number): { coins: Coins; got: number; spent: number } | null
nodes.body_text: function exchangeCoins(c: Coins, from: CoinKey, to: CoinKey, amount: number): { coins: Coins; got: number; spent: number } | null { if (from === to) return null; const amt = Math.min(Math.max(0, Math.floor(amount)), c[from]); const got = Math.floor((amt * CP[from]) / CP[to]); const spent = Math.ceil((got * CP[to]) / CP[from]); if (got <= 0) return null; return { coins: { ...c, [from]: c[from] - spent, [to]: c[to] + got }, got, spent }; }

'leve' : a.category === 'Média' ? 'media' : 'pesada'; return p.includes(key); }

nodes.name: weaponProficient
nodes.signature: function weaponProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, w: Weapon): boolean
nodes.body_text: function weaponProficient(cls: ClassDef | undefined, w: Weapon): boolean { if (!cls) return true; const list = cls.weaponProficiencies.map(normName); const cat = w.category === 'Simples' ? 'simples' : 'marciais'; if (list.some((p) => (p.includes('armas') || p.includes('todas')) && (p.includes(cat) || (cat === 'marciais' && p.includes('marcial'))))) return true; const name = singular(w.name); return list.some((p) => singular(p) === name); }

nodes.name: AttackInfo
nodes.body_text: interface AttackInfo { name: string; attackBonus: number; /** Expressão rolável (ex.: "1d8+3") ou null quando a arma não é da tabela. */ damageExpr: string | null; damageLabel: string; proficient: boolean; ability: 'For' | 'Des' | null; properties: string[]; }

nodes.name: weaponAttack
nodes.signature: function weaponAttack(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, it: Equipment): AttackInfo | null
nodes.body_text: function weaponAttack(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, it: Equipment): AttackInfo | null { const l = lookupItem(it.name); const magic = it.attack ?? 0; if (l?.kind !== 'weapon') { if (!magic) return null; return { name: it.name || 'Ataque', attackBonus: magic, damageExpr: null, damageLabel: '', proficient: false, ability: null, properties: [] }; } const w = l.weapon; const str = abilityModifier(c.strength), dex = abilityModifier(c.dexterity); const finesse = w.properties.includes('Acuidade'); const ability: 'For' | 'Des' = w.kind === 'À distância' ? 'Des' : finesse && dex > str ? 'Des' : 'For'; const mod = ability === 'Des' ? dex : str; const proficient = weaponProficient(cls, w); const dm = w.damage.match(/^(\d*d\d+|\d+)\s*(.*)$/); const dice = dm?.[1]; const bonus = mod + magic; const damageExpr = dice && /d/.test(dice) ? `${dice}${bonus ? (bonus > 0 ? `+${bonus}` : `${bonus}`) : ''}` : null; return { name: w.name, attackBonus: mod + (proficient ? proficiencyBonus(c.level) : 0) + magic, damageExpr, damageLabel: dm?.[2] ?? '', proficient, ability, properties: w.properties, }; }

nodes.name: critExpr
nodes.body_text: function critExpr(expr: string): string { return expr.replace(/^(\d*)d/, (_, n) => `${(Number(n || 1)) * 2}d`); }

nodes.name: equipWarnings
nodes.signature: function equipWarnings(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, items: Equipment[]): string[]
nodes.body_text: function equipWarnings(c: Character, cls: ClassDef | undefined, items: Equipment[]): string[] { const out: string[] = []; for (const it of items) { if (!isEquipped(items, it)) continue; const l = lookupItem(it.name); if (l?.kind === 'armor') { if (!armorProficient(cls, l.armor)) out.push(`Sem proficiência com ${l.armor.name}: desvantagem em testes/ataques/salvaguardas de For e Des e não pode conjurar.`); if (l.armor.strengthReq && c.strength < l.armor.strengthReq) out.push(`${l.armor.name} exige For ${l.armor.strengthReq}: −3 m de deslocamento.`); if (l.armor.stealthDisadvantage) out.push(`${l.armor.name}: desvantagem em Furtividade.`); } else if (l?.kind === 'weapon' && !weaponProficient(cls, l.weapon)) { out.push(`Sem proficiência com ${l.weapon.name}: sem bônus de proficiência no ataque.`); } } return out; }

nodes.name: levelup.ts
nodes.body_text: // Lógica pura do assistente de level up (sem React): calcula ganhos e monta o patch final. import { ABILITIES, abilityModifier, getClass, proficiencyBonus, spellSlotsFor, type AbilityKey, type ClassFeature, type Spell, type Subclass, } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { SCORE_FIELDS, getSheet, scoreOf, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import { spellPlan, type SpellPlan } from '../wizard/build'; import { initialState } from '../wizard/state'; import { hitDieAverage, pactSlots } from './logic'; const MOD_FIELDS = { str: 'strengthModifier', dex: 'dexterityModifier', con: 'constitutionModifier', int: 'intelligenceModifier', wis: 'wisdomModifier', cha: 'charismaModifier', } as const; /** Níveis com aumento de atributo/talento (guerreiro e ladino ganham extras). */ /** Nível em que a classe escolhe subclasse. */ /** Incrementos de atributo da escolha (sem validar o teto). */ /** Escolha completa e que não ultrapassa 20. */ /** Plano de magias reaproveitando spellPlan do wizard, com um estado sintético. */

nodes.name: HpMode
nodes.body_text: type HpMode = 'average' | 'roll';

nodes.name: AsiMode
nodes.body_text: type AsiMode = 'plus2' | 'plus1' | 'feat';

nodes.name: AsiChoice
nodes.body_text: interface AsiChoice { mode: AsiMode; a: AbilityKey | ''; b: AbilityKey | ''; feat: string }

nodes.name: LevelUpDraft
nodes.body_text: interface LevelUpDraft { hpMode: HpMode; /** Resultado do dado de vida rolado (null = ainda não rolou). */ hpRoll: number | null; subclassId: string; asi: AsiChoice; cantrips: string[]; spells: string[]; }

nodes.name: emptyDraft
nodes.body_text: emptyDraft = (): LevelUpDraft => ({ hpMode: 'average', hpRoll: null, subclassId: '', asi: { mode: 'plus2', a: '', b: '', feat: '' }, cantrips: [], spells: [], })

nodes.name: asiLevels
nodes.body_text: function asiLevels(classId: string): number[] { const extra = classId === 'guerreiro' ? [6, 14] : classId === 'ladino' ? [10] : []; return [4, 8, 12, 16, 19, ...extra].sort((x, y) => x - y); }

nodes.name: grantsAsi
nodes.body_text: grantsAsi = (classId: string, level: number) => asiLevels(classId).includes(level)

nodes.name: classSubclassLevel
nodes.body_text: classSubclassLevel = (subs: Subclass[]) => (subs.length ? Math.min(...subs.map((s) => s.level)) : undefined)

nodes.name: asiIncrements
nodes.body_text: function asiIncrements(asi: AsiChoice): Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> { if (asi.mode === 'feat') return {}; if (asi.mode === 'plus2') return asi.a ? { [asi.a]: 2 } : {}; const out: Partial<Record<AbilityKey, number>> = {}; if (asi.a) out[asi.a] = 1; if (asi.b && asi.b !== asi.a) out[asi.b] = (out[asi.b] ?? 0) + 1; return out; }

nodes.name: asiValid
nodes.signature: function asiValid(scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>, asi: AsiChoice): boolean
nodes.body_text: function asiValid(scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>, asi: AsiChoice): boolean { if (asi.mode === 'feat') return asi.feat.trim().length > 0; const inc = asiIncrements(asi); const total = Object.values(inc).reduce((n, v) => n + (v ?? 0), 0); if (total !== 2) return false; return (Object.entries(inc) as [AbilityKey, number][]).every(([k, v]) => scores[k] + v <= 20); }

nodes.name: scoresOf
nodes.body_text: function scoresOf(c: Character): Record<AbilityKey, number> { return Object.fromEntries(ABILITIES.map((a) => [a.key, scoreOf(c, a.key)])) as Record<AbilityKey, number>; }

nodes.name: planFor
nodes.signature: function planFor(classId: string, subclassId: string, level: number, scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>): SpellPlan | null
nodes.body_text: function planFor(classId: string, subclassId: string, level: number, scores: Record<AbilityKey, number>): SpellPlan | null { return spellPlan({ ...initialState(), classId, subclassId, level, abilityMode: 'manual', manual: scores }); }

nodes.name: slotsFor
nodes.signature: slotsFor = (plan: SpellPlan | null, level: number): number[]
nodes.body_text: slotsFor = (plan: SpellPlan | null, level: number): number[] => !plan ? [] : plan.sc.kind === 'pact' ? pactSlots(level) : spellSlotsFor(plan.sc.kind, level)

nodes.name: SpellChoices
nodes.body_text: interface SpellChoices { oldPlan: SpellPlan | null; newPlan: SpellPlan | null; oldSlots: number[]; newSlots: number[]; needCantrips: number; needSpells: number; cantripPool: Spell[]; spellPool: Spell[]; }

nodes.name: spellChoices
nodes.signature: function spellChoices(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): SpellChoices
nodes.body_text: function spellChoices(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): SpellChoices { const sheet = getSheet(c); const newLevel = c.level + 1; const before = scoresOf(c); const after = applyScores(before, draft, newLevel, sheet.classId); const subclassId = sheet.subclassId || draft.subclassId; const oldPlan = planFor(sheet.classId, sheet.subclassId ?? '', c.level, before); const newPlan = planFor(sheet.classId, subclassId, newLevel, after); const owned = new Set(sheet.spellsKnown); const delta = (k: 'cantrips' | 'known' | 'prepared') => Math.max(0, (newPlan?.[k] ?? 0) - (oldPlan?.[k] ?? 0)); const spellKey = newPlan?.mode === 'prepared' ? 'prepared' : 'known'; const cantripPool = (newPlan?.cantripList ?? []).filter((s) => !owned.has(s.id)); const spellPool = (newPlan?.spellList ?? []).filter((s) => !owned.has(s.id)); return { oldPlan, newPlan, oldSlots: slotsFor(oldPlan, c.level), newSlots: slotsFor(newPlan, newLevel), needCantrips: Math.min(delta('cantrips'), cantripPool.length), needSpells: Math.min(delta(spellKey), spellPool.length), cantripPool, spellPool, }; }

nodes.name: delta
nodes.body_text: delta = (k: 'cantrips' | 'known' | 'prepared') => Math.max(0, (newPlan?.[k] ?? 0) - (oldPlan?.[k] ?? 0))

nodes.name: applyScores
nodes.signature: function applyScores(base: Record<AbilityKey, number>, draft: LevelUpDraft, newLevel: number, classId: string)
nodes.body_text: function applyScores(base: Record<AbilityKey, number>, draft: LevelUpDraft, newLevel: number, classId: string) { const out = { ...base }; if (!grantsAsi(classId, newLevel) || !asiValid(base, draft.asi)) return out; for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(asiIncrements(draft.asi)) as [AbilityKey, number][]) out[k] = Math.min(20, out[k] + v); return out; }

nodes.name: LevelUpResult
nodes.body_text: interface LevelUpResult { newLevel: number; hitDie: number; hpBase: number; hpGain: number; /** PV retroativos por aumento de Constituição. */ hpRetro: number; pbOld: number; pbNew: number; scoresBefore: Record<AbilityKey, number>; scoresAfter: Record<AbilityKey, number>; features: ClassFeature[]; subclassNeeded: boolean; subclasses: Subclass[]; asiAvailable: boolean; spell: SpellChoices; /** Pendências que impedem confirmar (vazio = pronto). */ errors: string[]; columns: Partial<Character>; sheet: Partial<SheetData>; }

nodes.name: computeLevelUp
nodes.signature: function computeLevelUp(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): LevelUpResult
nodes.body_text: function computeLevelUp(c: Character, draft: LevelUpDraft): LevelUpResult { const sheet = getSheet(c); const cls = getClass(sheet.classId); const newLevel = Math.min(20, c.level + 1); const die = cls?.hitDie ?? 8; const before = scoresOf(c); const asiAvailable = grantsAsi(sheet.classId, newLevel); const asiOk = !asiAvailable || asiValid(before, draft.asi); const after = applyScores(before, draft, newLevel, sheet.classId); // PV: dado (média ou rolado) + mod. de Con novo; aumento de Con vale retroativamente. const hpBase = draft.hpMode === 'roll' ? (draft.hpRoll ?? 0) : hitDieAverage(die); const conOld = abilityModifier(before.con), conNew = abilityModifier(after.con); const hpRetro = (conNew - conOld) * c.level; const hpGain = Math.max(1, hpBase + conNew) + hpRetro; const subs = cls?.subclasses ?? []; const subLv = classSubclassLevel(subs); const subclassNeeded = !sheet.subclassId && subLv !== undefined && newLevel >= subLv; const subclassId = sheet.subclassId || draft.subclassId; const sub = subs.find((s) => s.id === subclassId); const features = [ ...(cls?.features ?? []).filter((f) => f.level === newLevel), ...(sub?.features ?? []).filter((f) => f.level === newLevel || (!sheet.subclassId && f.level <= newLevel)), ]; const spell = spellChoices(c, draft); const errors: string[] = []; if (c.level >= 20) errors.push('Nível máximo atingido.'); if (draft.hpMode === 'roll' && draft.hpRoll == null) errors.push('Role o dado de vida ou escolha a média.'); if (subclassNeeded && !draft.subclassId) errors.push(`Escolha ${cls?.subclassLabel.toLowerCase() ?? 'a subclasse'}.`); if (!asiOk) errors.push('Conclua o aumento de atributo ou talento (máx. 20).'); const cant = draft.cantrips.filter((id) => spell.cantripPool.some((s) => s.id === id)); const sp = draft.spells.filter((id) => spell.spellPool.some((s) => s.id === id)); if (cant.length < spell.needCantrips) errors.push(`Escolha ${spell.needCantrips - cant.length} truque(s).`); if (sp.length < spell.needSpells) errors.push(`Escolha ${spell.needSpells - sp.length} magia(s).`); // Patch consolidado const columns: Partial<Character> = { level: newLevel, maxHitPoints: c.maxHitPoints + hpGain, currentHitPoints: c.currentHitPoints + hpGain, }; const baseScores = { ...sheet.baseScores }; for (const a of ABILITIES) { const diff = after[a.key] - before[a.key]; if (diff > 0) { (columns as Record<string, unknown>)[SCORE_FIELDS[a.key]] = after[a.key]; (columns as Record<string, unknown>)[MOD_FIELDS[a.key]] = abilityModifier(after[a.key]); baseScores[a.key] = Math.min(20, baseScores[a.key] + diff); } } const known = [...sheet.spellsKnown, ...cant, ...sp]; if (cant.length || sp.length) columns.spells = [...new Set([...(c.spells ?? []), ...cant, ...sp])]; const chosen = [...sheet.chosenFeatures]; if (asiAvailable && asiOk) { if (draft.asi.mode === 'feat') chosen.push(`Nv ${newLevel}: Talento — ${draft.asi.feat.trim()}`); else chosen.push(`Nv ${newLevel}: ${Object.entries(asiIncrements(draft.asi)).map(([k, v]) => `+${v} ${ABILITIES.find((a) => a.key === k)?.name}`).join(', ')}`); } const used = [...sheet.spellSlotsUsed]; while (used.length < spell.newSlots.length) used.push(0); const sheetPatch: Partial<SheetData> = { baseScores, spellsKnown: known, spellsPrepared: spell.newPlan?.mode === 'prepared' ? [...sheet.spellsPrepared, ...sp] : sheet.spellsPrepared, spellSlotsUsed: used, chosenFeatures: chosen, ...(subclassId ? { subclassId } : {}), }; return { newLevel, hitDie: die, hpBase, hpGain, hpRetro, pbOld: proficiencyBonus(c.level), pbNew: proficiencyBonus(newLevel), scoresBefore: before, scoresAfter: after, features, subclassNeeded, subclasses: subs, asiAvailable, spell, errors, columns, sheet: sheetPatch, }; }

nodes.name: logic.ts
nodes.body_text: import { ARMOR, abilityModifier, getClass, levelForXp, rollDice, type ClassDef } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import { getSheet, type SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import { isEquipped } from './equipment-logic'; /** Dados de vida restantes. */ /** Sobe um nível: PV máximos aumentam pela média do dado de vida + mod. de Constituição. */ /** Aplica dano consumindo PV temporários primeiro. */ /** Bruxo: magia de pacto. */ /** Calcula a CA com base nos itens equipados (casando nomes com a tabela de armaduras). */

nodes.name: hitDieAverage
nodes.body_text: hitDieAverage = (die: number) => Math.floor(die / 2) + 1

nodes.name: hitDiceLeft
nodes.body_text: hitDiceLeft = (c: Character, sheet: SheetData) => Math.max(0, c.level - sheet.hitDiceUsed)

nodes.name: canLevelUp
nodes.body_text: function canLevelUp(c: Character) { return c.level < 20 && levelForXp(c.experience) > c.level; }

nodes.name: levelUpPatch
nodes.body_text: function levelUpPatch(c: Character): Partial<Character> { const cls = getClass(getSheet(c).classId); const die = cls?.hitDie ?? 8; const gain = Math.max(1, hitDieAverage(die) + abilityModifier(c.constitution)); return { level: c.level + 1, maxHitPoints: c.maxHitPoints + gain, currentHitPoints: c.currentHitPoints + gain, }; }

nodes.name: applyDamage
nodes.signature: function applyDamage(c: Character, amount: number): Partial<Character>
nodes.body_text: function applyDamage(c: Character, amount: number): Partial<Character> { const fromTemp = Math.min(c.temporaryHitPoints, amount); const rest = amount - fromTemp; return { temporaryHitPoints: c.temporaryHitPoints - fromTemp, currentHitPoints: Math.max(0, c.currentHitPoints - rest), }; }

nodes.name: applyHealing
nodes.signature: function applyHealing(c: Character, amount: number): Partial<Character>
nodes.body_text: function applyHealing(c: Character, amount: number): Partial<Character> { return { currentHitPoints: Math.min(c.maxHitPoints, c.currentHitPoints + amount) }; }

nodes.name: spendHitDie
nodes.body_text: function spendHitDie(c: Character, sheet: SheetData) { const die = getClass(sheet.classId)?.hitDie ?? 8; const r = rollDice(`1d${die}`); if (!r || hitDiceLeft(c, sheet) <= 0) return null; const heal = Math.max(0, r.total + abilityModifier(c.constitution)); return { die, roll: r.total, heal, hp: Math.min(c.maxHitPoints, c.currentHitPoints + heal) }; }

nodes.name: longRestPatch
nodes.body_text: function longRestPatch(c: Character, sheet: SheetData) { const recovered = Math.max(1, Math.floor(c.level / 2)); return { columns: { currentHitPoints: c.maxHitPoints, temporaryHitPoints: 0 } as Partial<Character>, sheet: { spellSlotsUsed: [], hitDiceUsed: Math.max(0, sheet.hitDiceUsed - recovered), deathSaves: { successes: 0, failures: 0 }, // recursos de descanso curto/longo voltam; "manual" fica como está resources: sheet.resources.map((r) => (r.recharge === 'manual' ? r : { ...r, used: 0 })), concentratingOn: null, exhaustion: Math.max(0, sheet.exhaustion - 1), } as Partial<SheetData>, }; }

nodes.name: pactSlots
nodes.body_text: function pactSlots(level: number): number[] { const count = level === 1 ? 1 : level < 11 ? 2 : level < 17 ? 3 : 4; const slotLevel = Math.min(5, Math.ceil(level / 2)); const arr = Array(slotLevel).fill(0); arr[slotLevel - 1] = count; return arr; }

nodes.name: preparedLimit
nodes.signature: function preparedLimit(cls: ClassDef | undefined, level: number, abilityMod: number)
nodes.body_text: function preparedLimit(cls: ClassDef | undefined, level: number, abilityMod: number) { const sc = cls?.spellcasting; if (!sc?.preparesSpells) return null; const base = sc.kind === 'full' ? level : Math.floor(level / 2); return Math.max(1, abilityMod + base); }

nodes.name: AcBreakdown
nodes.body_text: interface AcBreakdown { total: number; parts: string[] }

nodes.name: computeArmorClass
nodes.signature: function computeArmorClass(c: Character, classId: string): AcBreakdown
nodes.body_text: function computeArmorClass(c: Character, classId: string): AcBreakdown { const dex = abilityModifier(c.dexterity); const all = c.equipment ?? []; const items = all.filter((it) => isEquipped(all, it)); const parts: string[] = []; let body: { name: string; base: number; dex: boolean; cap?: number } | null = null; let shield = 0; let flat = 0; for (const it of items) { const armor = ARMOR.find((a) => a.name.toLowerCase() === it.name.trim().toLowerCase()); if (!armor) { if (it.defense) { flat += it.defense; parts.push(`${it.name} +${it.defense}`); } continue; } if (armor.category === 'Escudo') { shield = 2; parts.push(`${armor.name} +2`); continue; } const base = parseInt(armor.ac, 10); const cand = { name: armor.name, base, dex: armor.ac.includes('Des'), cap: armor.ac.includes('máx') ? 2 : undefined }; if (!body || cand.base > body.base) body = cand; } let total: number; if (body) { const d = body.dex ? Math.min(dex, body.cap ?? 99) : 0; total = body.base + d; parts.unshift(`${body.name} ${body.base}${body.dex ? ` ${d >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${d} (Des)` : ''}`); } else if (classId === 'barbaro') { total = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(c.constitution); parts.unshift('Defesa sem armadura: 10 + Des + Con'); } else if (classId === 'monge' && shield === 0) { total = 10 + dex + abilityModifier(c.wisdom); parts.unshift('Defesa sem armadura: 10 + Des + Sab'); } else { total = 10 + dex; parts.unshift(`Base 10 + Des (${dex >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${dex})`); } return { total: total + shield + flat, parts }; }

nodes.name: resources.ts
nodes.body_text: // Sugestões de recursos por classe (regras 5e do Livro do Jogador) a partir do nível. import type { ResourceDef } from '@/lib/sheet'; export const RECHARGE_LABEL: Record<ResourceDef['recharge'], string> = { short: 'Descanso curto', long: 'Descanso longo', manual: 'Manual', }; /** Bônus de dano da Fúria por nível de bárbaro. */

nodes.name: ResourceSuggestion
nodes.body_text: type ResourceSuggestion = Omit<ResourceDef, 'used'>;

nodes.name: step
nodes.body_text: step = (level: number, table: [number, number][]) => table.reduce((v, [lv, n]) => (level >= lv ? n : v), 0)

nodes.name: suggestResources
nodes.signature: function suggestResources(classId: string, level: number, mods: { cha: number }): ResourceSuggestion[]
nodes.body_text: function suggestResources(classId: string, level: number, mods: { cha: number }): ResourceSuggestion[] { const r = (id: string, name: string, max: number, recharge: ResourceDef['recharge']): ResourceSuggestion => ({ id, name, max, recharge }); const out: ResourceSuggestion[] = []; switch (classId) { case 'barbaro': // 20º nível: usos ilimitados (representado por 99) out.push(r('furia', 'Fúria', level >= 20 ? 99 : step(level, [[1, 2], [3, 3], [6, 4], [12, 5], [17, 6]]), 'long')); break; case 'bardo': out.push(r('inspiracao-bardo', 'Inspiração de Bardo', Math.max(1, mods.cha), level >= 5 ? 'short' : 'long')); break; case 'clerigo': out.push(r('canalizar', 'Canalizar Divindade', step(level, [[2, 1], [6, 2], [18, 3]]), 'short')); if (level >= 10) out.push(r('intervencao', 'Intervenção Divina', 1, 'long')); break; case 'druida': if (level >= 2) out.push(r('forma-selvagem', 'Forma Selvagem', 2, 'short')); break; case 'feiticeiro': if (level >= 2) out.push(r('pontos-feiticaria', 'Pontos de Feitiçaria', level, 'long')); break; case 'guerreiro': out.push(r('retomar-folego', 'Retomar o Fôlego', 1, 'short')); if (level >= 2) out.push(r('surto-acao', 'Surto de Ação', level >= 17 ? 2 : 1, 'short')); if (level >= 9) out.push(r('indomavel', 'Indomável', step(level, [[9, 1], [13, 2], [17, 3]]), 'long')); break; case 'mago': out.push(r('recuperacao-arcana', 'Recuperação Arcana', 1, 'long')); break; case 'monge': if (level >= 2) out.push(r('ki', 'Pontos de Ki', level, 'short')); break; case 'paladino': out.push(r('maos-curativas', 'Cura pelas Mãos (PV)', level * 5, 'long')); out.push(r('sentido-divino', 'Sentido Divino', Math.max(1, 1 + mods.cha), 'long')); if (level >= 3) out.push(r('canalizar', 'Canalizar Divindade', 1, 'short')); break; default: break; } return out.filter((s) => s.max > 0); }

nodes.name: r
nodes.signature: r = (id: string, name: string, max: number, recharge: ResourceDef['recharge']): ResourceSuggestion
nodes.body_text: r = (id: string, name: string, max: number, recharge: ResourceDef['recharge']): ResourceSuggestion => ({ id, name, max, recharge })

nodes.name: rageDamage
nodes.body_text: rageDamage = (level: number) => (level >= 16 ? 4 : level >= 9 ? 3 : 2)

nodes.name: rest.ts
nodes.body_text: // Planejamento de descansos: calcula o que será recuperado antes de aplicar. import { abilityModifier, formatModifier } from '@repo/rules'; import type { Character } from '@/lib/api'; import type { SheetData } from '@/lib/sheet'; import { longRestPatch } from './logic'; /** Descanso curto: aplica os dados de vida já rolados (cada valor = resultado do dado). */ /** Descanso longo completo. */

nodes.name: RestPlan
nodes.body_text: interface RestPlan { lines: string[]; columns: Partial<Character>; sheet: Partial<SheetData>; }

nodes.name: shortRestPlan
nodes.signature: function shortRestPlan(c: Character, sheet: SheetData, diceRolls: number[]): RestPlan
nodes.body_text: function shortRestPlan(c: Character, sheet: SheetData, diceRolls: number[]): RestPlan { const conMod = abilityModifier(c.constitution); const heal = diceRolls.reduce((s, r) => s + Math.max(0, r + conMod), 0); const hp = Math.min(c.maxHitPoints, c.currentHitPoints + heal); const lines: string[] = []; if (diceRolls.length) { lines.push(`${diceRolls.length} dado(s) de vida (${diceRolls.join(', ')} ${formatModifier(conMod)} Con cada): +${hp - c.currentHitPoints} PV (${c.currentHitPoints} → ${hp})`); } else lines.push('Nenhum dado de vida gasto.'); const resources = sheet.resources.map((r) => (r.recharge === 'short' && r.used > 0 ? { ...r, used: 0 } : r)); const reset = sheet.resources.filter((r) => r.recharge === 'short' && r.used > 0).map((r) => r.name); if (reset.length) lines.push(`Recursos restaurados: ${reset.join(', ')}`); const patch: Partial<SheetData> = { hitDiceUsed: sheet.hitDiceUsed + diceRolls.length, resources }; if (sheet.classId === 'bruxo' && sheet.spellSlotsUsed.some((n) => n > 0)) { patch.spellSlotsUsed = []; lines.push('Espaços de magia de pacto restaurados'); } if (sheet.classId === 'mago') lines.push('Recuperação Arcana: restaure espaços manualmente na aba Magias (uma vez por dia).'); return { lines, columns: { currentHitPoints: hp }, sheet: patch }; }

nodes.body_text: function longRestPlan(c: Character, sheet: SheetData): RestPlan { const p = longRestPatch(c, sheet); const regained = Math.max(1, Math.floor(c.level / 2)); const lines = [ `PV: ${c.currentHitPoints} → ${c.maxHitPoints}${c.temporaryHitPoints ? ' (PV temporários zerados)' : ''}`, `Dados de vida: +${Math.min(regained, sheet.hitDiceUsed)} recuperado(s)`, 'Todos os espaços de magia restaurados', ]; const reset = sheet.resources.filter((r) => r.recharge !== 'manual' && r.used > 0).map((r) => r.name); if (reset.length) lines.push(`Recursos restaurados: ${reset.join(', ')}`); if (sheet.concentratingOn) lines.push('Concentração encerrada'); if (sheet.exhaustion > 0) lines.push(`Exaustão: ${sheet.exhaustion} → ${sheet.exhaustion - 1} (requer comida e água)`); if (sheet.deathSaves.successes || sheet.deathSaves.failures) lines.push('Salvaguardas contra morte zeradas'); return { lines, columns: p.columns, sheet: p.sheet }; }

nodes.body_text: function spellRollFor(s: Spell, castLevel: number): SpellRoll | null { const m = s.description.match(DICE); if (!m) return null; let n = Number(m[1]); const sides = Number(m[2]); const flat = m[3] ? Number(m[3]) : 0; const near = s.description.slice(Math.max(0, (m.index ?? 0) - 80), (m.index ?? 0) + 120).toLowerCase(); const heal = /cura|recupera|pontos de vida/.test(near) && !/dano/.test(near); if (!heal && !/dano/.test(s.description.toLowerCase())) return null; if (s.level > 0 && castLevel > s.level && s.atHigherLevels) { const up = s.atHigherLevels.match(/(\d+)d(\d+)/i); if (up && Number(up[2]) === sides) n += Number(up[1]) * (castLevel - s.level); } return { expr: `${n}d${sides}${flat ? `+${flat}` : ''}`, kind: heal ? 'cura' : 'dano' }; }

Seguro para SSR: servidor vê lista vazia. */

nodes.name: read
nodes.body_text: function read(): string[] { try { const raw = localStorage.getItem(KEY); if (raw === cache.raw) return cache.list; const parsed = raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : []; const list = Array.isArray(parsed) ? parsed.filter((x): x is string => typeof x === 'string') : EMPTY; cache = { raw, list }; return list; } catch { return EMPTY; } }

nodes.name: subscribe
nodes.body_text: function subscribe(cb: () => void) { listeners.add(cb); const onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === KEY) cb(); }; window.addEventListener('storage', onStorage); return () => { listeners.delete(cb); window.removeEventListener('storage', onStorage); }; }

nodes.name: onStorage
nodes.body_text: onStorage = (e: StorageEvent) => { if (e.key === KEY) cb(); }

nodes.name: useSpellFavorites
nodes.body_text: function useSpellFavorites() { const favorites = useSyncExternalStore(subscribe, read, () => EMPTY); const toggle = useCallback((id: string) => { const cur = read(); const next = cur.includes(id) ? cur.filter((x) => x !== id) : [...cur, id]; try { localStorage.setItem(KEY, JSON.stringify(next)); } catch { /* storage indisponível */ } listeners.forEach((l) => l()); }, []); return { favorites, toggle }; }
